adjacent turn + fire.notes: E-to-NE turns the whole figure; tucked passing becomes an extended contact while the next muzzle flash appears. No waist splice.

opposite turn.notes: NE-to-SW reverses whole-body art and new bullets travel southwest; passing becomes contact without a firing reset.

speed up.notes: Eastward cadence advances from tucked passing through extended contact and rear swing while firing; still fast-walk reuse.

speed down + stop fire.notes: Westward recoil settles and slower passing follows rear swing. No idle freeze during movement.

stop + planted fire.notes: Residual stride settles into W idle; both boots then remain planted across muzzle flashes without stationary pedaling.

resume.notes: From planted W the whole figure faces E, rear swing advances into narrow passing and movement resumes with gun raised.

reviewScope: Aim-only regression of the user-accepted MVP. Native 1920x1080 capture and 144 sequential decoded samples inspected; browser video playback/decoding verified. Known six-frame fast-walk and minor drift limitations preserved. Not new gait artwork or an actual Luna run.
